missing_token.en: Missing token. Provide token in Authorization header or as query parameter 'token'
missing_token.zh: 缺少 Token，请通过 Authorization 请求头或 token 查询参数提供

invalid_token.en: Your token is invalid or expired

auth_json_object.en: Upstream authentication must be a JSON object
auth_json_object.zh: 上游认证配置必须是 JSON 对象

auth_fields_mismatch.en: Authentication fields do not match the selected authorization type
auth_fields_mismatch.zh: 认证字段与所选授权方式不匹配

auth_token_url_invalid.en: token_url must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URL
auth_token_url_invalid.zh: token_url 必须是有效的 HTTP/HTTPS 地址

auth_scopes_invalid.en: scopes must be an array of permission scope strings
auth_scopes_invalid.zh: scopes 必须是权限范围字符串数组

document_paths_required.en: Document must contain a paths object
document_paths_required.zh: 文档必须包含 paths 对象

document_title_invalid.en: info.title must be a nonblank string
document_title_invalid.zh: info.title 必须是非空字符串

document_paths_invalid.en: Paths and methods must have valid formats
document_paths_invalid.zh: paths 中的路径及方法格式不正确

document_operation_id_invalid.en: operationId must be a nonblank string
document_operation_id_invalid.zh: operationId 必须是非空字符串

document_duplicate_tools.en: Tool names must be unique within a document
document_duplicate_tools.zh: 同一文档内的工具名称不能重复

document_invalid.en: Invalid OpenAPI structure or YAML/JSON format
document_invalid.zh: OpenAPI 文档结构或 YAML/JSON 格式不正确

stored_document_invalid.en: Stored document cannot be parsed. Edit it to repair it
stored_document_invalid.zh: 已存文档无法解析，请编辑修复

document_not_found.en: Service document not found. Refresh the list
document_not_found.zh: 服务文档不存在，请刷新列表

document_tool_conflict.en: Tool names conflict with another service. Adjust operationId and retry
document_tool_conflict.zh: 工具名称与其他服务冲突，请调整 operationId 后重试

document_content_required.en: No file or YAML string provided
document_content_required.zh: 未提供文件或 YAML 字符串

document_fields_required.en: Missing required fields: org, app, fileName

identifier_invalid.en: {field} must be a nonblank identifier of at most {limit} characters without whitespace or /\?#
identifier_invalid.zh: {field} 必须是最多 {limit} 个字符的非空标识，不能包含空白或 /\?#

expiry_timezone_required.zh: 到期时间必须包含时区

app_scope_org_required.en: An app scope requires an org
app_scope_org_required.zh: 应用范围必须指定组织

service_scope_required.en: Service selection requires org and app
service_scope_required.zh: 选择服务必须指定组织和应用

admin_mcp_restricted.en: Administrator tokens are restricted to management. Use a database MCP credential or enable ADMIN_MCP_ENABLED.
admin_mcp_restricted.zh: 管理员 Token 仅限管理接口。请使用数据库 MCP 凭证或启用 ADMIN_MCP_ENABLED。

management_access_denied.en: MCP credentials cannot access management APIs
management_access_denied.zh: MCP 凭证不能访问管理接口

tenant_access_denied.en: Token does not permit this tenant
tenant_access_denied.zh: Token 不允许访问此租户

tenant_not_found.en: Tenant not found. Return to the tenant portal and select a tenant
tenant_not_found.zh: 租户不存在，请返回租户入口重新选择

tenant_not_empty.en: Tenant still has services or access credentials. Remove them before deleting
tenant_not_empty.zh: 租户仍有服务或访问凭证，请先清空后再删除

credential_tenant_mismatch.en: Authorization rules must belong to the current tenant
credential_tenant_mismatch.zh: 授权规则必须属于当前租户

credential_service_not_found.en: Authorization rules reference missing services. Refresh the selection list
credential_service_not_found.zh: 授权规则包含不存在的服务，请刷新候选列表

validation_string_type.en: Input should be a valid string

validation_int_parsing.en: Input should be a valid integer

validation_bool_parsing.en: Input should be a valid boolean

document_timeout_invalid.en: {method} {path}: x-request-timeout-seconds must be a finite positive number
